verdict.rationale: Honeycomb ships a built-in AI feature, Query Assistant, which turns natural-language input into Honeycomb queries. That covers one narrow kind of delegation inside the product. The MCP server and agent-skills plugin connect external AI agents to Honeycomb rather than providing an assistant in the product, so they don't count toward this story. Missing for 10: an in-product assistant that can take on multi-step tasks beyond query generation (e.g., running investigations, creating boards or triggers), detailed documentation of the assistant's scope, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
